pages.text: $(li)Do not increase buffer capacities (e.g., Will Steel buffers) by 32× (e.g., from 2048 to 65536), as this causes severe performance issues.

$(li)The item filter can only handle up to one stack (64) of an item; for larger amounts, use XNet or SFM instead.$(li)RFTools Crafter cannot be used for certain recipes (e.g., Definer); you must use a Sequential Fabricator instead.
$(li)In the ME Mythic Assembler, recipe ingredients (e.g., Cursed Sapphire, Mithrillium Catalyst) are consumed unless the tooltip explicitly states otherwise.

$(li)To enable on-demand crafting with ME Machinery Input Bus, use an AE2 subnet: place an interface with patterns on the input inventory, then connect a storage bus to the same inventory and link it to the Machinery Input Bus set to stock a large quantity of ingredients.
$(li)If a Mythic Processor isn’t crafting, verify the interface is attached directly to the input bus, and ensure no duplicate recipes exist elsewhere in your AE network.
$(li)Some recipes (e.g., Black Iron) do not fit into the ludicrous-tier output hatch when using Tier 3 mythic coils; reduce coil tier or upgrade output hatch capacity to avoid overflow.
$(li)One bucket of Astral Water is sufficient to run one full cycle of the Mythic Assembly—craft just that amount per run to avoid waste.
